gaps.sentence: The hotel was full, so we couldn't check ___.
gaps.explanation: check in = register; check out = leave and pay.

gaps.sentence: I've mixed ___ the twins' names again.
gaps.explanation: mix up = confuse one thing/person with another.

gaps.sentence: The company was ___ up by a larger rival last year.
gaps.explanation: 'Take over/take up a company' — here 'was taken up' = absorbed by a bigger firm.

gaps.sentence: Their son grew ___ and moved abroad.
I bumped ___ my neighbour at the dentist's.
gaps.explanation: bump into somebody = meet by chance.

gaps.sentence: The caterpillar will turn ___ a butterfly.
The flood wiped ___ the entire harvest.
The factory laid ___ two hundred workers.
gaps.explanation: lay off = dismiss workers because there is not enough work.
